잠언-4-1.title: 잠언 4장 1절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-4-1.exegesis: 32-35. Reasons for the warning. froward-- ( Pr 2:15 ). secret ... righteous-- in their communion ( Am 3:7 ).
잠언-4-1.theologicalNote: 32-35. Reasons for the warning. froward-- ( Pr 2:15 ). secret ... righteous-- in their communion ( Am 3:7 ).

잠언-4-2.title: 잠언 4장 2절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-4-2.exegesis: CHAPTER 4 Pr 4:1-27 . To an earnest call for attention to his teachings, the writer adds a commendation of wisdom, preceded and enforced by the counsels of his father and teacher. To this he adds a caution (against the devices of the wicked), and a series of exhortations to docility, integrity, and uprightness. 1-2. (Compare Pr 1:8 ). to know-- in order to know. doctrine-- the matter of learning ( Pr 1:5 ), such as he had received ( La 3:1 ).

잠언-4-4.title: 잠언 4장 4절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-4-4.exegesis: 3. father's son-- emphatic, a son specially regarded, and so called tender, as an object of special care (compare 1Ch 22:7 ; 29:1 ); an idea further expressed by only beloved-- or, "as an only son" ( Ge 22:2 ), though he had brothers (see on 1Ch 3:5 ).

잠언-4-5.title: 잠언 4장 5절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-4-5.exegesis: 4. He taught-- or directed me. retain-- as well as receive. keep ... and live-- observe, that you may live ( Pr 7:2 ).
잠언-4-5.theologicalNote: 4. He taught-- or directed me. retain-- as well as receive. keep ... and live-- observe, that you may live ( Pr 7:2 ).

잠언-4-6.title: 잠언 4장 6절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-4-6.exegesis: 5. Get-- as a possession not to be given up. neither decline-- that is, from obeying my word.
잠언-4-6.theologicalNote: 5. Get-- as a possession not to be given up. neither decline-- that is, from obeying my word.

잠언-4-7.title: 잠언 4장 7절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-4-7.exegesis: 6. Not only accept but love wisdom, who will keep thee from evil, and evil from thee.
잠언-4-7.theologicalNote: 6. Not only accept but love wisdom, who will keep thee from evil, and evil from thee.

잠언-4-8.title: 잠언 4장 8절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-4-8.exegesis: 7. (Compare Job 28:28 ). getting-- or possession; a desire for wisdom is wise.
잠언-4-8.theologicalNote: 7. (Compare Job 28:28 ). getting-- or possession; a desire for wisdom is wise.

잠언-4-9.title: 잠언 4장 9절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-4-9.exegesis: 8. As you highly esteem her, she will raise you to honor. embrace her-- with fond affection.
잠언-4-9.theologicalNote: 8. As you highly esteem her, she will raise you to honor. embrace her-- with fond affection.

잠언-4-10.title: 잠언 4장 10절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-4-10.exegesis: 9. ornament-- such as the chaplet or wreath of conquerors. deliver-- (Compare Ge 14:20 ). The allusion to a shield, contained in the Hebrew, suggests protection as well as honor (compare Pr 4:6 ).

잠언-4-17.title: 잠언 4장 17절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-4-17.exegesis: 16-17. The reason is found in the character of sinners, whose zeal to do evil is forcibly depicted ( Pr 6:4 ; Psa 36:5 ). They live by flagrant vices ( Pr 1:13 ). Some prefer to render, "Their bread is wickedness, their drink violence" (compare Job 15:16 ; 34:7 ).

잠언-4-19.title: 잠언 4장 19절 역사문법적 주해
